subject.title: Feature: preserve completed progress draft in Telegram progress mode

question: Should Telegram progress mode gain a default-off option that preserves the full completed progress draft, including checklist-style state, while sending the final answer as a separate normal message?
rationale: Current source and docs intentionally use a compact collapse summary and strict progress config; preserving the full draft changes public config, message lifecycle, and retained disclosure behavior that automation should not choose.

options.title: Accept default-off preserve mode
options.body: Add a documented Telegram-owned option that preserves the full completed progress draft and proves the separate-final-answer flow while keeping today's collapse summary as the default.

options.title: Keep collapse summary
options.body: Decline full completed-draft preservation for now and keep the current final answer plus one-line activity digest behavior.

options.title: Defer to structured progress cards
options.body: Track the request as part of a broader structured progress-card API so checklist state is defined once across channels.

recommendation.title: Accept default-off preserve mode
recommendation.body: Add a documented Telegram-owned option that preserves the full completed progress draft and proves the separate-final-answer flow while keeping today's collapse summary as the default.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter Lindsey has the most directly targeted recent history on the Telegram collapse-summary lifecycle this option would extend.
